items.item_text: Masters degree in business administration, public health administration, operations, or a related field. Equivalent work experience with a bachelors degree is acceptable.
Minimum ten (10) years of experience in strategic planning, operations, healthcare management, or consulting, with proven leadership in managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience within large health care delivery organizations including integrated care delivery systems.
Experience with care delivery models, population health, or payer-provider integration.
Experience leading a PMO, managing project portfolios, and driving change enablement in complex, matrixed environments.
Strategic Planning & Integration
Lead the design and implementation of NHP strategies aimed at growth, efficiency, and market responsiveness.
Develop and manage the comprehensive integration plan and operational framework, ensuring all strategic initiatives are aligned and connected across NHP and its interdependencies.
Ensure alignment across care delivery, market strategy, network management, and support functions to drive holistic success.
Design scalable operating models and partner with business units to drive consistent, standardized operations that enable strategy execution.
Project & Portfolio Management
Lead the NHP Project Management Office (PMO), establishing NHP-wide standards, governance, tools, and best practices.
Monitor initiative performance across the portfolio to ensure on-time, on-budget, and in-scope delivery.
Develop and implement planning, prioritization, and resource allocation processes to maximize impact and efficiency.
Change Enablement & Organizational Readiness
Build and implement change enablement strategies to ensure readiness, engagement, and adoption across NHP.
Partner with HR, Communications, and functional leaders to support transitions tied to acquisitions, restructures, and strategic pivots.
Facilitate cross-functional alignment across clinical, operational, financial, network, and market teams to enable seamless execution.
Provide executive leadership with visibility into initiative performance, barriers to execution, and required interventions.
Process Improvement & Standardization
Identify, design, and implement NHP process improvements to enhance quality, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.
Drive operational excellence through the use of continuous improvement methodologies.
Strategy Evaluation & Playbook Development
Evaluate and assess new business models, strategic initiatives, and products for operational feasibility and alignment.
Develop repeatable implementation playbooks and toolkits to guide future market launches, service line expansions, or operational transformations.
Deep understanding of operational integration, change management, and business model design.
Demonstrated success in translating strategy into action through rigorous planning, stakeholder engagement, and execution oversight.
In-depth understanding of current health benefits market forces and their implications for health plans, care delivery systems, and Kaiser Permanente.
Comprehensive understanding of Kaiser Permanentes mission, organizational structure, strategy, distinctive features, and value proposition.
Strong problem-solving, data analysis, and communication skills, with the ability to influence at all levels.
Ability to work effectively in matrixed environments, managing competing priorities and diverse stakeholder groups.
High business acumen, with a focus on outcomes, accountability, and performance metrics.
